```json
{
  "subtype": "focus_inference",
  "implied_focus": "The clinical nature of the patient's presenting concern (what kind of medical problem prompted the visit), characterised by its clinical category, body system, acuity/chronicity, and the care response it triggers",
  "per_column": [
    {"name": "clinical_category", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Directly typologises the presenting concern by medical domain -- the core of 'main types of concerns'."},
    {"name": "visit_purpose", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Frames why the patient came (acute vs chronic vs wellness), a key facet of concern type."},
    {"name": "problem_acuity", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Ordinal severity of the concern; a coherent attribute of the presenting problem."},
    {"name": "chronicity", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "New vs chronic vs exacerbation -- a temporal facet of the concern."},
    {"name": "care_action_type", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Downstream response; somewhat orthogonal to concern-type but coheres as a consequence facet."},
    {"name": "body_system", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Anatomical categorisation of the concern; overlaps heavily with clinical_category but at a slightly different granularity."},
    {"name": "symptom_mechanism", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Pathophysiologic mechanism behind the concern -- a genuine explanatory facet."},
    {"name": "referral_or_escalation", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Escalation outcome; a downstream facet, more about disposition than concern type."},
    {"name": "preventive_flag", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Flags preventive dimension of the visit; ties to concern typology but is a narrow secondary axis."}
  ],
  "focus_coherence": 0.85,
  "structure_quality": 0.78,
  "focus_actionability": 0.85,
  "rationale": "The columns collectively centre on one coherent, data-inferable focus: the clinical characterisation of the patient's presenting concern. clinical_category, body_system, symptom_mechanism, problem_acuity, chronicity, and visit_purpose form a well-differentiated multi-facet structure (domain, anatomy, mechanism, severity, time course, purpose) that directly serves 'main types of concerns' at a useful granularity -- not a single restatement nor generic noise. Coherence is strong though slightly diluted by clinical_category and body_system being near-duplicate axes, and by care_action_type / referral_or_escalation / preventive_flag drifting toward downstream disposition rather than the concern itself. Still, these read as coherent consequence facets rather than a grab-bag. The implied focus is highly actionable: an analyst can cluster and rank concern types, cross-tabulate against department/urgency/age_group, and investigate care patterns. Structure_quality is docked modestly for the categorical redundancy between the two taxonomy columns."
}
```
